name: walked-into-container-left-empty-keeps-its-residue
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.28 (the cbor wire): Ruling 31: lat (7.1) and lon (7.2) walk into the map at 7 and write no value (lat holds null and is absent, ruling 6; lon is missing), so no line writes at 7 (ruling 21 does not apply) and 7 takes its residue 7.9 back: a2 00 01 07 a1 09 617a. The null at 7.1 is a mapped item and is not written back. Derived without an engine by a standalone RFC 8949 codec.
